title: Phone numbers, texts and calls
content:
# Phone numbers, texts and calls

Get a phone number in Zernio, then text and call from it in the dashboard or through your AI assistant. Also iMessage, RCS and WhatsApp.

Zernio isn't only social accounts. You can get a business phone number, text from it and take calls in your browser, all next to your posts.

## Get a number

In the [dashboard](https://zernio.com/dashboard/phone-numbers-overview), open **Phone** and click **Buy number**. Then pick:

1. The **country**. The price is next to each one.
2. The **type**: local or toll-free.
3. **What it runs**: calls, SMS and WhatsApp, or iMessage.
4. The **area code**, then the exact number, or **Any number** for the fastest one.

<StepVideo src="/videos/for-you/phone-buy-number.mp4" caption="Picking a new Los Angeles number" />

Local numbers in the US, Canada, the UK and most of Europe are $3 a month. Some countries ask for documents first. See [Phone number prices](/pricing/phone) and [Phone numbers](/platforms/phone-numbers).

![Your numbers in the Phone section](/docs-static/phone/numbers.png)

## Send texts

A new number can receive texts right away.

To send from a **US** number, register your business first under **Phone** > **10DLC**. Carriers review it, so start early.

Numbers in other countries can send as soon as SMS is on. See [Carrier registration](/platforms/sms/setup) and [SMS rates](/pricing/phone).

## Make and take calls

**Phone** > **Calls** has a phone in your browser and the history of every call. Each number can have voicemail, business hours and a menu.

Recording and transcription are optional extras. See [Voice and calls](/platforms/voice) and [Calling from the browser](/platforms/voice/browser-calling).

## Other ways to message

| Channel | What you need |
|---|---|
| [iMessage](/platforms/imessage) | A dedicated US or UK sender, $200 a month. Blue bubbles, with text fallback. |
| [RCS](/platforms/rcs) | An agent the carriers approve, which takes 4 to 6 weeks in the US. |
| [WhatsApp](/platforms/whatsapp) | A WhatsApp Business account. Meta reviews the templates you start conversations with. |

## Ask your assistant

Phone, texting and calls work through the same Zernio connection as your posts. The assistant finds the right action on its own.

<PromptList
  items={[
    { prompt: "Which phone numbers do I have in Zernio, and what can each one do?" },
    { prompt: "Find me a local phone number in Los Angeles. Don't buy it yet." },
    { prompt: "Text +1 555 010 0199 from my Zernio number: \"Your order is ready for pickup.\"" },
    { prompt: "Show the calls I missed this week." },
  ]}
/>

The CLI covers the inbox, broadcasts and WhatsApp, but not SMS or calls yet. See [CLI: inbox](/cli/inbox).
